{esc(dateText(inv.invoiceDate))}</div></div>
            <div class="data-row"><div class="label">Due Date:</div><div class="value" style="font-weight:400">${esc(dateText(inv.dueDate))}</div></div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <table class="items">
          <thead><tr><th>Description</th><th>Quantity</th><th>Cost</th><th>Amount</th></tr></thead>
          <tbody>${rows || `<tr><td colspan="4" style="height:1.1in"></td></tr>`}</tbody>
        </table>
        <div class="bottom-area">
          <div class="signature-box">
            <img class="signature-image" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Miguel A. Castro authorized signature">
            <div class="sig-line">Manager’s Signature</div>
            <div class="sig-name">Miguel A. Castro</div>
          </div>
          <div class="totals">
            <div class="row"><span>Subtotal</span><strong>${money(subtotalFor(inv))}</strong></div>
            <div class="row"><span>Taxes</span><strong>${inv.taxRate?money(taxFor(inv)):"—"}</strong></div>
            <div class="row total"><span>Total</span><span>${money(totalFor(inv))}</span></div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="invoice-footer">
          <div class="tagline">QUALITY SPACES. STRONGER COMMUNITIES.</div>
          <div class="thanks">Thank you for your trust and partnership!</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
    ${photoPages}
  `;
}

function renderAll(){renderList();renderPreview()}

$("newInvoiceBtn").onclick=()=>{
  saveFormIntoCurrent();
  const inv=defaultInvoice();state.invoices.push(inv);state.currentId=inv.id;persist();fillForm(inv);renderAll();
};
$("saveBtn").onclick=()=>{saveFormIntoCurrent();renderAll();alert("Invoice saved on this device.");};
